messages:
olivia: spotting a small but reproducible delta between preview and finalizer for route-tagged requests (tag=priority-alpha). Preview shows ~96k tokens, finalizer ~92k for same hour. Anyone seen tag-based routing affecting sampling?
raj: that could happen if the route-tag is added by the edge after preview sampling. Do we attach tags in the proxy now?
olivia: sample events: 
```
preview picks:
{tenant: core-ai, req_id: r-9001, route: chat-stream, tags: [] , tokens: 40}
finalizer picks:
{tenant: core-ai, req_id: r-9001, route: chat-stream, tags: ["priority-alpha"], tokens: 40}
```
raj: aha. Preview sampled before tag enrichment; finalizer sees tag and applies per-tag quota/sampling which changed inclusion. deploy-bot: "deployed tag-enricher v1.4 to edge-proxies at 11:10 UTC"
frank: so root cause: sampling key mismatch: preview sampling_key=(tenant,route) while finalizer sampling_key=(tenant,route,tags.priority). If tag enrichment happens between preview and finalizer, parity breaks.
marta: mitigation path: (1) make sampling key ignore tags that are enrichment-only (2) move tag enrichment earlier before preview sampling (3) make finalizer fallback to tag-agnostic sampling for parity windows.
raj: short-term: flip finalizer to ignore ephemeral tags for the last-24h window. I can push a config toggle.
olivia: any risk of under/over counting if we ignore tags? The tag is used for charge differentiation for a few beta tenants.
frank: for billing correctness, tags affect price, but parity is first. We should ensure tag-aware billing is applied at charge time not at sampling stage. For now, fallback preserves counts but we need a post-process to annotate charged items with tag pricing when available.
ui-bot: "opened ENG-10012: finalizer-ignore-ephemeral-tags-toggle and ENG-10013: tag-enrichment-ordering-audit"
raj: rolling toggle to canary now for us-east-1. :rocket:
raj: canary done at 11:18 UTC. preliminary metrics: preview_vs_finalizer_token_delta_percent dropped from 4.1% to 0.2% for core-ai.
olivia: great. Longer-term: propose a small API contract: tags must be stable prior to preview sampling OR preview must record pre-enrichment tag state so finalizer can reconcile. Add CI contract test.
marta: UX: console should mark invoice preview rows where tag-stability is unknown and show a tooltip "tag enrichment may change final counts". Filing ENG-10014 for console UX.
frank: I'll own a follow-up to design charge-time tag reconciliation to ensure price correctness without breaking sampling parity (ENG-10015).
olivia: thanks all. Keeping the parity card on for 48h and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
